scope: Four fixed models on the 18-task proportional Terminal-Bench Pro wave-two panel

run_controls.batching: one task across four fixed models
run_controls.cost_attribution: one cost-owning task batch at a time; compare routes with cache-aware catalog list price

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: no overlapping task batches; all sandboxes must be Harbor-managed and cleaned after each batch

execution_order: run one four-route smoke task from wave two
verify all four learning labels, exact task spend, sandbox cleanup, and task-tree integrity
continue one four-route task batch at a time only if the smoke is valid
interpretation_guard: Wave two is outcome-blind proportional expansion. Do not select tasks based on expected model disagreement.
